Definition: happy; Asher, a son of Jacob, and the tribe descended from him, with its territory; also a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Asher = "happy"; 1) son of Jacob and Zilpah; 2) the tribe descended from Asher; 3) a city east of Shechem in Manasseh
